caption:
TRACE ANALYSIS | One same-trace discovery start per method/QPS. No GPU-exclusive time claim.
These cut4 pure axes and Hybrid4/f1/8 are not iso-work. A longer host enclosure does not prove a causal TTFT penalty.
Use the separate common admission A/B to test that hypothesis.

cases.name: RemoteSetupAB_Discovery200_q1.8_NativeSetup_v1
cases.scope: The B8192 lower bound counts query tokens,not token-layer rows. The aligned Hybrid bound includes its mandatory prefix/suffix boundary. Extra calls can reflect legal multi-request packing,not an implementation error. Intervening decode time is an overlap of host engine-step enclosures,not exclusive GPU compute or causal slowdown. An earlier first prepare can move waiting inside this enclosure without changing completion time. This audit does not prove that disabling packing improves serving.
